wsdd2.description: Configuration namespace for wsdd2 daemon options.

wsdd2.daemon.description: Fork off a child process to become a daemon.

wsdd2.debug_llmnr.description: Print out LLMNR debug messages to stdout.

wsdd2.debug_llmnr_level.description: LLMNR debug level. Multiple -L flags increase verbosity. Defaults to 1 if debug is enabled.

wsdd2.debug_wsdd.description: Print out WSDD debug messages to stdout.

wsdd2.debug_wsdd_level.description: WSDD debug level. Multiple -W flags increase verbosity. Defaults to 1 if debug is enabled.

wsdd2.interface.description: Use only specified interface to reply. Empty string listens on all capable interfaces.

wsdd2.hostname.description: Specify string as host name. Empty uses system hostname.

wsdd2.netbios_name.description: Specify string as NETBIOS machine name. Empty uses testparm output or system hostname.

wsdd2.workgroup.description: Specify string as workgroup name. Empty uses testparm output or 'WORKGROUP'.

wsdd2.properties.description: WSDD query over HTTP response values in a comma-delimited list of 'key:val' strings.
